svg.title: Net interest rose from $240.7 billion in fiscal 2016 to $1,051.8 billion in fiscal 2026, the largest rise of any budget function.
svg.desc: Dumbbell chart of net federal outlays by budget function in fiscal 2016 and 2026, in billions of dollars. Social Security rose from 916.1 to 1,667.1, Medicare from 594.5 to 1,072.6 and net interest from 240.7 to 1,051.8, the largest rise. Education, training, employment and social services held near 108. Offsetting receipts, counted as negative outlays, went from minus 95.3 to minus 155.0. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. On a computer without both fonts, the labels fall back to another font and change width.
